key_insight: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks combine inspectable Reynolds-stress closures with separate estimates of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports uncertainty-aware RANS predictions, including wake-flow bounds for unseen three-dimensional wind-farm layouts.
method: Learn anisotropy using a tensor basis that enforces Galilean and rotational invariance, symmetry, and tracelessness.
Place variational posteriors on spline coefficients; regularise physical realisability separately.
Propagate posterior samples through RANS, injecting aleatoric uncertainty as a spatially correlated field.
evidence_signal: A controlled regression benchmark favoured spline-coefficient posteriors overall; turbulence evaluations showed calibrated in-distribution uncertainty and wind-farm transfer to unseen layouts.
watch_item: Under geometric extrapolation, epistemic uncertainty increases but still underestimates growing prediction errors.
paper_title: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks for trustworthy Reynolds-stress closures
